skill.name: okx-agentic-wallet
skill.description: Operate an OKX Agentic Wallet through the onchainos CLI for balances, transfers, swaps, bridges, gas payments, strategy orders, portfolio checks, security scans, and audit log guidance.
skill.summary: Route OKX Agentic Wallet requests to safe onchainos wallet, trading, bridge, gas, portfolio, and security workflows.
skill.author: internet-court

security_audit.summary: AI review found no prompt-injection text or obvious credential exfiltration intent. Most static hits are Markdown examples, OKX documentation links, fixed onchainos workflow references, or safety instructions. Confirmed risks remain because the skill executes an external wallet CLI, uses environment-based API credentials, references hidden local workflow files, and can guide value-moving on-chain actions.

remediation.issue: Environment-based API key login handles high-value secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Keep secrets inside the onchainos CLI, redact all credential fields, and require explicit user intent before API key login.

remediation.issue: Hidden local workflow references use ~/.onchainos paths.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer packaged relative workflow references or require explicit user confirmation before loading any hidden home-directory workflow.

remediation.issue: Preflight can install or force-upgrade the external CLI.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit user approval before installer or upgrade commands, and display the source URL and checksum verification result.

remediation.issue: State-changing wallet commands can move funds or bypass warnings with force after confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Preserve confirmation gates, show concrete fund-loss risks, log transaction summaries, and never add force flags without a fresh explicit approval.

semantic_findings.title: Preflight Can Trigger CLI Installation Or Forced Upgrade
semantic_findings.description: The preflight flow follows CLI-supplied action instructions and can run installer or forced upgrade paths when onchainos is missing or integrity checks fail. This expands trust to external CLI output and installer artifacts.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The referenced lines instruct the agent to read data.action, do what it says, and run an installer fallback. The flow includes checksum verification, so the risk is operational rather than clear malware.

semantic_findings.title: Agent Executes Value-Moving Wallet Operations
semantic_findings.description: The skill routes sends, contract calls, swaps, bridges, limit orders, and transaction broadcasts through onchainos. These workflows can move assets or expand spending authority when a user confirms them.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The routing table explicitly includes funds-moving wallet actions and the command-building rules require confirmation for state-changing commands. This is core skill behavior, not an inferred risk.

semantic_findings.title: User-Authorized Automated Transaction Paths
semantic_findings.description: The bridge guidance allows silent or automated mode only with explicit authorization, and Gas Station can silently broadcast when configured. These paths need strong consent and logging controls because they reduce per-transaction review.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both files describe automatic or silent transaction handling after setup or authorization. The text includes safeguards, so the risk is controlled but still real for a wallet skill.

content.user_title: Operate OKX Agentic Wallet from AI
content.value_statement: Managing on-chain wallet actions across tools is slow and error-prone. This skill routes wallet, swap, bridge, gas, strategy, portfolio, and security requests through OKX onchainos workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes wallet login, account status, addresses, balances, transaction history, and audit log guidance.
Guides user-confirmed sends, contract calls, message signing, and wallet policy or export portal flows.
Supports OKX swap, cross-chain bridge, limit-order strategy, transaction gateway, and Solana Gas Station workflows.
Uses security scan guidance for token, DApp, transaction, signature, and approval checks.
Provides formatting rules for transaction hashes, token amounts, risk warnings, confirmations, and localized responses.
limitations: Requires the onchainos CLI and an authenticated OKX Agentic Wallet session for wallet operations.
State-changing actions can move funds and require explicit user confirmation before execution.
Feature support depends on OKX backend availability, supported chains, token coverage, and region access.
Does not provide investment advice or guarantee final on-chain settlement after broadcast.

use_cases.title: Check wallet state before a transfer
use_cases.description: Review login status, wallet address, token balances, and risk context before sending assets.

use_cases.title: Execute a cross-chain asset move
use_cases.description: Compare bridge routes, confirm fees and destination details, then track arrival status after broadcast.

use_cases.title: Screen risky tokens and approvals
use_cases.description: Run token, transaction, DApp, signature, and approval checks before interacting with unknown assets.

prompt_templates.title: Check My Wallet
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my OKX Agentic Wallet status and show my balances on Solana and Ethereum.

prompt_templates.title: Send With Confirmation
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me send 25 USDC on Solana. Show the recipient, fee information, and wait for my confirmation before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Bridge And Track
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the best route to bridge 100 USDC from Arbitrum to Base, explain fees, then track the transfer after I approve it.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Before Contract Call
prompt_templates.prompt: Before I approve this contract interaction, scan the transaction, explain any risks, and only proceed if I explicitly confirm.

output_examples.output: A concise balance summary with each chain, token symbol, user-unit amount, USD value, and abbreviated contract address.
A route comparison with estimated receive amount, minimum receive amount, bridge fee, estimated time, approval need, and a confirmation prompt.

output_examples.input: Is this token safe to buy?
output_examples.output: A token risk summary with the overall risk level, triggered labels, tax information when available, and the recommended action.

best_practices: Confirm every recipient address, chain, token, amount, fee, and route before any state-changing action.
Run the relevant security scan before contract calls, swaps, approvals, signatures, or unknown DApp interactions.
Use fresh CLI output for wallet addresses, transaction hashes, order IDs, and status checks.
anti_patterns: Do not pass force flags on the first attempt or bypass a risk warning without explicit user approval.
Do not ask users to paste seed phrases, private keys, session tokens, API secrets, or passwords.
Do not guess token contract addresses, bridge IDs, relayer IDs, chain names, or transaction hashes.

faq.question: Does this skill move funds?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide sends, swaps, bridges, contract calls, and orders through onchainos after explicit confirmation.

faq.question: Does it need an OKX wallet login?
faq.answer: Wallet operations require a logged-in OKX Agentic Wallet session. Public address portfolio and some security scans may not require login.

faq.question: Can it export my private key or seed phrase?
faq.answer: No. Export is handled on the OKX web portal, and the skill instructs the agent not to display secrets.

faq.question: Can it pay Solana gas with stablecoins?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports OKX Gas Station flows when the CLI and backend report an eligible Solana transaction.

faq.question: Does it support every chain and token?
faq.answer: No. Support depends on the onchainos CLI, OKX backend coverage, and the specific wallet, swap, bridge, or strategy feature.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. It presents wallet data, route data, and risk scan results, but it does not recommend investments.
